action_items: Optional: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 6 stale failures unrelated to this refactor — register tests expect old schema (pre-consent), file-upload tests don't confirm questionnaire first, drive tests expect not-configured. Consider updating these to reflect the current API contract (or add pytest.mark.skip). Not blocking the regression.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext refactor is clean: all 5 fns wrapped in useCallback with correct [] deps (they read state via api client, not stale closures); provider value memoized via useMemo including all deps.
DossierPage.load uses useCallback([id]) — correct: id is the only external dep. useEffect([load]) is idiomatic and refreshes correctly on id change.
DoctorDashboard.load uses useCallback([]) with useEffect([load, searchParams]) — searchParams-driven toasts remain reactive; load itself doesn't need re-creating.
PatientDashboard.load useCallback([]) + useEffect([load]) + call to load() inside create() ensures the list re-fetches after POST — verified live (16→17 cards).

PaymentResult.jsx now reads sessionStorage on render (not in useEffect). Because component re-renders on state change (polling→paid/timeout), the pending_payment link is resolved at each render — works, but if the tab was reopened and sessionStorage cleared, the fallback /dashboard link is used. Acceptable.
sessionStorage vs localStorage tradeoff: pending_payment is short-lived per-tab context; sessionStorage is correct choice (auto-cleared on tab close, avoids stale data across sessions).
Minor: PaymentSuccess useEffect deps only include [searchParams] but the tries ref is fine (mutable ref). No lint issues expected.
Backend tests already load credentials from env via load_dotenv — good, no more hardcoded creds.
